webster.text: Not daunted; not subdued or depressed by fear; intrepid.

example.quote: No, sir ; those brave republicans have acquired their reputation no less by their undaunted intrepidity than by the wisdom of their frugal and economical policy.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 7, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
